LESSON: FRACTIONS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.1: Fractions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Fractions
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain equal parts of a whole
2. find simple fractions of amounts

SECTION 3: PICTURES

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-212.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 212]]

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-033.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 33]]

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-038.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 38]]

SECTION 4: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Fractions

Teach
• A fraction names equal parts of a whole.
• In 1/2, the whole is split into 2 equal parts; you take 1.

Worked example
• 1/2 of 12 mangoes = 6
• 1/4 of 20 = 5
• 3/4 means 3 equal parts out of 4

Try this
• 1/2 of 10
• 1/4 of 16
• (Check later: 5; 4)


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• 1/2 of 12 = 6
• 1/4 of 20 = 5

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Find 1/2 and 1/4 of classroom totals (learners, desks).

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Draw shapes and shade 1/2 and 1/4.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Denominator = equal parts of the whole.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
